caption: The drawing depicts a teapot designed to resemble a small, round cottage. The body of the teapot is illustrated as a cylindrical house with tan bricks and features architectural elements such as two rectangular windows with crosshatched blue glass panes and brown frames, and a front door that is arched and painted red with a small round window above it. The door is surrounded by green foliage dotted with small red berries or flowers. Above the door is a small, triangular dormer window with a red roof and blue panes. The lid of the teapot forms the roof of the cottage, colored in light brown and shaded in a way that suggests thatch, with green leaves scattered across its surface. The spout is shaped like a gnarled tree branch, painted in brown and tapering outward, and the handle on the opposite side is similarly rendered to resemble a dark brown, natural tree limb, curving upward. The artist’s signature, “Erwin Schwabe,” appears on the right side of the drawing near the base. The drawing is set against a light, unadorned background.
title: Teapot
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
